descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer with strong technical expertise and excellent German language skills to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data solutions, building robust data pipelines, and optimizing data processing workflows.
 You will work closely with international teams and business stakeholders to transform complex data requirements into reliable and efficient technical solutions.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines and data processing solutions.
Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for data integration and transformation.
Develop and maintain data architectures, data models, and data warehouses.
Work with large and complex datasets to ensure data quality, consistency, and performance.
Implement data processing solutions using Python, SQL, and relevant data engineering technologies.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, software engineers, and business stakeholders.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines and workflows.
Ensure data security, governance, and compliance with relevant standards.
Contribute to architectural decisions and technical improvements.
Participate in technical discussions and communicate with German-speaking stakeholders.
 Requirements 
5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering or a similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines.
Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling.
Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience with big data technologies and distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark or PySpark.
Knowledge of orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or similar.
Experience working with relational and non-relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, data governance, and data integration principles.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with international teams.
 Good command of German (B2/C1 level) and English. 
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.
Knowledge of Kafka or other event-streaming technologies.
Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Previous experience working in international or German-speaking environments.
